card.line: Gomorrah was a city of the plain near Sodom. Its great sin brought God's judgment, and the Bible uses its fall as a warning.

moments.title: Defeated in the Valley of Siddim
moments.text: The king of Gomorrah and four other kings fought four kings in the Valley of Siddim. As the kings of Sodom and Gomorrah fled, some men fell into tar pits, and the enemy took the goods and food of both cities.

moments.title: The LORD Hears the Outcry
moments.text: The LORD told Abraham that the outcry against Sodom and Gomorrah was great and their sin was very grievous. He said He would go down to see if their actions fully justified the outcry.

moments.title: Fire from Heaven
moments.text: The LORD rained sulfur and fire on Sodom and Gomorrah. He destroyed the cities, the whole plain, and everyone and everything in them. Lot's wife looked back and became a pillar of salt.

moments.title: Smoke Over the Plain
moments.text: Early the next morning Abraham looked down toward Sodom and Gomorrah and saw smoke rising like smoke from a furnace. God remembered Abraham and brought Lot out of the catastrophe.
